description: Baugher: with the Rhode Island Army NG at Quonset in 1989; noted on display at the Beverly Municipal Airport war memorial September 2007 and later to VFW Post 545 Beverly - the helicopter was donated by the Rhode Island Army National Guard. An OSM node tagged Bell UH-1 Iroquois in the current extract fixes it at 42.58600 -70.91196 on the airport.
